ideas.pitch: An AI-powered diagnostic agent that analyses game project runtime logs and pinpoints cascading logic bugs across multiple interconnected scripts.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2 (Game Debugging) and Final Round (Finals Challenge): Complex game projects containing functional bugs, interconnected systems, and cascading errors.
ideas.title: GlitchTrace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the core debugging theme of the event, inspired by successful AI diagnostic tools that streamline error tracing and multi-file root cause analysis.

ideas.pitch: A command-line tool designed for game developers that turns obscure runtime error stack traces into structured, patch-ready repair files.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 & Round 2: Pseudo-code debugging and locating functional bugs in project files under severe time pressure.
ideas.title: BugHero CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the diagnostic speed and systems thinking criteria evaluated by the Game Developers Association (GDA) CRCE judges.

ideas.pitch: A high-performance log-ingestion and visualization dashboard built to track game system states and locate race conditions during complex runtime executions.
ideas.problem_statement: Final Round (Finals Challenge): Complex final project containing interconnected systems and cascading bugs.
ideas.title: SysDebug LogManager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors award-winning server log management platforms, demonstrating robust engineering and real-time diagnostic visibility that appeals to systems-focused judges.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent knowledge repository that indexes past debugging sessions, error resolutions, and team notes to deliver instant solutions when similar bugs reappear.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1 and Round 2: Diagnostic speed and practical fixability under time pressure across multiple pseudo-code and game bug rounds.
ideas.title: KnowledgeFix Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines developer tool efficiency with retrieval-augmented workflows proven successful in engineering productivity hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An automated pull request reviewer that evaluates bug fixes submitted during competitive debugging rounds for logic regressions and side effects.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2 & Final Round: Locating and fixing functional bugs without breaking interconnected game systems.
ideas.title: PatchReview AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages automated code review concepts that excel by catching regressions instantly, impressing judges with rigorous quality control.
